entity: Secretary of the United States Department of Transportation
stance_basis: paraphrase describes Secretary's letter as setting study scope/constraints, no position on project merits
summary: The Secretary of the United States Department of Transportation is referenced in the document as having issued a December 22, 1976 letter that stipulated the evaluation be limited to rail rapid transit and bus modes in the Regional Core Area. This reference establishes the administrative and procedural framework for the alternatives analysis rather than expressing support or opposition to the project itself. The Secretary's role is presented as a scoping authority rather than as a stakeholder with a substantive position on the project.
complaint_summary: The Secretary of the U.S. Department of Transportation issued a December 22, 1976 letter stipulating that the evaluation be limited to rail rapid transit and bus modes in the Regional Core Area, thereby defining the scope of the alternatives analysis.
summary_quote: this evaluation was limited to rail rapid transit and bus modes in the Regional Core Area as stipulated in the December 22, 1976 letter from the Secretary of the United States Department of Transportation.
